summary: Round 4 testing of (1) booking deletion (table row trash + detail 'Hapus') and (2) photo selection by filename/label. Found and fixed a BUILD-BREAKING JSX syntax error in BookingDetail.jsx (missing </Dialog>) that made the entire frontend fail to compile. After the fix, all Round-4 frontend flows pass. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_round4.py (15 new tests); full suite 87/88 pass. One real backend bug (500 instead of 404) and two integrity/RBAC-UI gaps found. bookings/payments/notifications collections left EMPTY as requested.

critical.issue: Non-existent booking_id returns 500 Internal Server Error. add_photos() never checks the booking exists: update_one matches 0 docs, then `b = await db.bookings.find_one(...)` returns None and `b.get('photos')` raises AttributeError. Must return 404 'Booking tidak ditemukan' (same guard as add_payment).

minor.issue: Deletes the booking + payments but NOT its notifications. Verified: after deleting test bookings, 30 orphaned notifications remained in db.notifications with booking_id pointing to deleted bookings — they still render in the Notifikasi page and link to a 404 booking. Add `await db.notifications.delete_many({'booking_id': booking_id})`.
Returns 200 {ok:true} even for a non-existent booking/photo (no 404). Inconsistent with other endpoints.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: missing closing </Dialog> tag (invoice preview Dialog opened at L359 was never closed; the new AlertDialog was inserted before it). Caused 'SyntaxError: Unterminated JSX contents (419:10)' -> webpack compile failure -> ENTIRE app showed the CRA error overlay and no route rendered. Verify the fix is kept.

Row delete trash icon and 'Booking Baru' button are rendered for the photographer role without any role gate. Photographer clicks trash -> AlertDialog -> DELETE returns 403 and only an 'Akses ditolak' toast appears. Should be wrapped in a canManage check like BookingDetail does.

issues: Date range filters use native browser date inputs (type="date", showing mm/dd/yyyy US format) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere — inconsistent with the Bahasa Indonesia UI
Bookings table overflows horizontally at 1920px; the 'Sisa' column / trash column sit at the extreme right edge with almost no right padding
'Tanggal'/'Waktu' edit fields also use native date/time pickers (12/23/2026, 11:00 AM) — locale mismatch with Indonesian UI

action_items: Add 404 guard for a missing booking in POST /api/bookings/{id}/photos (currently 500)
Delete related notifications in DELETE /api/bookings/{id} (orphans currently remain)
Gate the row trash icon + 'Booking Baru' button in Bookings.jsx behind an owner/admin role check
Keep the </Dialog> fix in BookingDetail.jsx; add a lint/build check before handing off (a JSX syntax error broke the whole app)
Optional: replace native date/time inputs with shadcn Calendar + id-ID locale for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: add_photos() in /app/backend/bookings.py mutates then reads without existence check -> NoneType AttributeError; mirror the pattern in add_payment().
delete_booking() cascades to payments only; notifications (and any future related collections) should be cascaded too.
Frontend RBAC is enforced inconsistently: BookingDetail uses canManage, Bookings.jsx does not. Extract a shared canManage hook.
BookingDetail.jsx is 422 lines with the invoice preview dialog, photo gallery, payments and delete dialog all inline — split into subcomponents before it grows past 700 lines.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Round-4 flows after the build fix

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASSING (do not retest unless changed): bookings empty state 'Tidak ada data.'; create booking via admin dialog; row trash -> AlertDialog cancel keeps row / confirm deletes row + cascades payments; detail 'Hapus' -> AlertDialog -> redirect to /admin/bookings + GET returns 404; DELETE as photographer 403, anon 401/403, unknown id 404; POST /photos label-vs-URL split (url='' + label for filenames, derived label for URLs); admin grid renders font-mono label tiles + for URL photos; portal label tiles toggle + counter, manual-photo-input/button adds pre-selected tile, submit-selection-button -> submit-confirm-ok -> locked (manual add & toggles return 400, submit controls hidden); admin detail shows 'Sudah dikirim klien' + counter 2/5; public booking form at / end-to-end (invoice + portal link shown); auth playbook items (httpOnly cookies, $2b$ bcrypt, 5-fail lockout, explicit CORS origins with credentials) covered by tests/test_auth.py. Run backend tests with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q` (pytest.ini already has xdist args; do NOT pass -n/-p flags). ALWAYS re-run tests/cleanup_test_data.py + purge orphaned notifications afterwards so the user's DB stays empty.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend total outage RCA: in BookingDetail.jsx the new delete AlertDialog was inserted between </DialogContent> and the (now missing) </Dialog>, leaving the invoice Dialog element unterminated. Babel failed to parse the module, webpack emitted 2 errors and CRA served the error overlay for every route, so nothing was testable until the closing tag was restored. Backend 500 RCA: POST /bookings/{id}/photos performs $push then re-reads the booking; for an unknown id find_one returns None and .get() raises AttributeError -> unhandled 500. Orphan notification RCA: delete_booking cascades only to db.payments.
